Container.Name: CNGI-WebPortal
Container.Overview: Public website and secure portal entry point for Robert Clemons A/C and Clemons NextGen Integrations. Provides the public website now and is the foundation for authenticated customer and employee portal experiences.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port used to open CNGI WebPortal. Container port remains 8080.

Config.Name: Login URL
Config.Description: Authentik or portal login destination. Leave blank until the production login route is configured.

Config.Name: Service Request URL
Config.Description: Destination for Request Service. Leave blank until the Core-backed intake workflow is configured.
